description: This file defines various functional React components for the marketing section of a web application, including navigation, hero section, statistics, and footer, with UI elements like buttons, links, and animations.

methods.name: MarketingNav
methods.description: Top navigation component for the landing page, including logo, navigation links, and auth buttons.

methods.name: NavLink
methods.description: Helper component for animated navigation link with hover underline effect.

methods.name: MarketingHero
methods.description: Hero section component with headline, description, call-to-action buttons, and a statistics overview.

methods.name: Stat
methods.description: Component to display individual statistic with icon, label, and value.

methods.name: MarketingFooter
methods.description: Footer component with branding, navigation links, and copyright info.
